newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to delay output, export order annoucement.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to delay output, export order annoucement.

text.p: Taiwan's economics ministry said on Monday it was postponing its Monday's scheduled announcement of December's industrial output and export orders indices to Tuesday.

"For several reasons, the economics ministry will delay the announcement of December export orders and industrial output indices to 1030 a.m. (0230 GMT) on January 21," the ministry said in a statement.
The statement did not specify reasons for the delay.
Industrial output rose 3.22 percent year-on-year in November while export orders fell 4.16 percent year-on-year.

A Reuters polls on January 16 of five economists produced an average forecast for a rise of 2.99 percent in annual industrial output growth in December and an average forecast for a rise of 1.64 percent for annual export orders growth in December.
